IBM Bob... I'm not sure why no one is using it - it's the best of everything and being completely slept on... It's built as an orchestrator it works with pretty well every model and between anthropic, openai, IBM's models, It scales across entire software development lifecycles (SDLC). It supports self-hosted, air-gapped on-premise deployments for banks and governments, includes built-in governance, and features specialized capabilities for legacy code modernization (like Java upgrades or Mainframe/COBOL translation).

The best part is that ensures you only pay for that premium logic when you absolutely need it, removing that layer and keeping costs down... I still use all the same models and all the same principles/patterns and honestly I get better results as it augments all the models and companies...
